operations.name: app.guide
operations.description: START HERE: conventions (mm, Z up, face and edge keys, references, expressions), feature kinds, error codes and ready-to-run recipes.

operations.name: app.status
operations.description: Engine state (installed, running, busy, and setup: the one-off download of the engine on a new computer, with state ready, pending, downloading, installing, failed or off and its progress), the build running now, queued builds, parts by status and open requests.

operations.name: settings.get
operations.description: Units, navigation, projection, grid, materials with densities, default material, how long agent edits wait.

operations.description: Change settings: display_unit, navigation, projection, show_grid, materials (JSON list of {name, density}), default_material, agent_wait_s.

display_unit.description: mm or in (display only; data is always mm)

navigation.description: Which mouse button rotates the view

default_material.description: Material for new parts (a name from materials)

agent_wait_s.description: Default seconds an agent edit waits for its build (0-25)

operations.name: jobs.run
operations.description: Run maintenance now: prune (old builds and pictures), requeue (interrupted builds), engine_start (load the geometry engine ahead of a series of edits; a no-op when it is running), engine_test (start the engine and time a sample part) or engine_install (start, or retry after a failure, the one-off download of the geometry engine; it runs in the background and app.status shows its progress).
